features.additionalInfo: Adding an additional cardholder is an easy way to share the convenience and accessibility of your CommBank credit card, without opening a new account. You can have one additional cardholder and they must be at least 16 years old. They'll get a card with their name but with your account number.

Through AutoPay, you can choose to have the full closing balance, the minimum amount due, or set an amount debited from your chosen CommBank transaction account. If the set amount isn't enough to cover the minimum payment shown on your current statement, we'll take out more to cover the difference. If the set amount is more than your closing balance shown on your current statement, only the closing balance amount is debited.
With BPAY View you can switch to online bills & ask billers to send them directly to the CommBank app or NetBank, making it easy to see, track, and pay bills online.

Qantas Frequent Flyer members can opt-in with an annual fee of $90 to earn Qantas Points on everyday purchases using a CommBank Awards credit card. Use your Qantas Points to choose from thousands of rewards such as flights, flight upgrades, hotel stays, wine or shopping at Qantas Marketplace. Points you earn are transferred to your Qantas Frequent Flyer account at the end of each statement period at a rate of 2.5 CommBank Awards points to 1 Qantas Point. Easily check your Qantas Points balance. through your Qantas Frequent Flyer account. To opt-in, choose Qantas Points instead of CommBank Awards points in your credit card application. Existing CommBank Awards cardholders can opt-in to Qantas Points via the CommBank Awards website or by calling 13 16 61. From 25 August 2023, this card will be ineligible to opt-in to earn Qantas Points. Existing Awards cards opted-in to earn Qantas Points prior to 25 August 2023, may remain opted-in.

Access the CommBank Awards program and earn Awards points as soon as you start using your CommBank Awards credit card. You can earn points on everyday credit card purchases with no expiry on points,  redeem Awards points for a range of Awards items on the Awards site including at Myer, Gift Cards or cashback, easily check your Awards points balance in NetBank or the CommBank app and earn Bonus Points when you make purchases with your credit card at one of our bonus partners including the Bonus Points eShop.

Earn 1 Awards point for every $1 spent using your Mastercard Standard Awards card, up to and including $2,000 in a statement period. After spending $2,000, the Awards point earn rate is 0.5 Awards points per $1 spent. Earn Bonus Points when you make purchases with your credit card at one of our bonus partners including the Bonus Points eShop. Bonus points do not expire and there is no cap on how many bonus points you can earn each year. The earning and redemption of CommBank Awards points are subject to the Commonwealth (CommBank) Awards Program Terms & Conditions.

The SurePay - Balance Plan is an instalment plan feature available to help you manage your credit card repayments. You can break down your credit card purchase balance into smaller, manageable instalments with a fixed term and no set up fee. Your card purchase interest rate, or special interest rate, will be applied to the balance and Terms and Conditions apply.

The SurePay - Cash Advance Plan is an instalment plan feature available to help you manage your credit card repayments. You can break down your cash advance balance into smaller, manageable instalments with a fixed term and no set up fee. Your cash advance interest rate will apply to the balance and Terms and Conditions apply.

The SurePay - Purchase Plan is an instalment plan feature available to help you manage your credit card repayments. You can split your purchases into smaller, manageable instalments with a fixed term and 0% interest rate for purchases in an instalment plan. A set-up fee and minimum term applies and is subject to Terms and Conditions. The SurePay - Purchase Plan is considered an Instalment Feature of the account. For further information refer to the BankingProductInstalments Open Banking API.
